stockDetail.overview: AnaptysBio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on delivering immunology therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its clinical-stage pipeline includes rosnilimab, a selective pathogenic T cell depleter, for which it has completed a Phase 2b trial for the treatment of moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis (RA), ANB033, a CD122 antagonist, in a Phase 1b trial for celiac disease (CeD) and eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), and ANB101, a BDCA2 modulator, in a Phase 1a trial. Rosnilimab is an IgG1 antibody that directly targets pathogenic T cells. Its segments include Biopharma and Royalty Management. Its Biopharma segment focuses on the development and potential commercialization of innovative immunology therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its Royalty Management segment manages the financial collaboration for Jemperli from GSK plc and for imsidolimab from Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc.
